Overview / Features
Program sections

One incident. Connected workspaces.

Explore each section of ArcHorizon, from command decisions and search planning to field reporting and the incident record.

Command & coordination

  • Incident CommandA command view of incident priorities, organization, and decisions.
  • OperationsTeam assignments, task progress, and operational organization.
  • PlanningObjectives, strategies, operational periods, and planning-cycle work.
  • Situational AwarenessA common operating picture from live status, maps, and field reports.

Operations tools

  • Tasks & assignmentsDefine, assign, map, track, and close operational work.
  • Teams & crewsStaffing, capability, equipment, status, and activity in one record.
  • Status boardsTeam availability and task progress in separate, connected views.

Search & geography

  • Mapping & GISOperational geometry, map layers, and geographic exchange.
  • SAR ToolsSearch areas, patterns, probability planning, and SAR-specific tools.

Information & public affairs

  • Intelligence & InformationSubjects, clues, observations, leads, and the intel record.
  • Public AffairsPublic messaging, press releases, and misinformation tracking.
  • LiaisonAgency status, contacts, coordination, and partner feedback.

Support & safety

  • Safety & Medical SupportHazards, operational risk, release checks, and medical support context.
  • WeatherIncident forecasts, aviation conditions, and alert monitoring.
  • LogisticsResource requests, equipment support, and accountability.
  • CommunicationsChannel plans, radio resources, and field communications.
  • FinanceCost forecasts and resource consumption planning.

Records & field

  • Documentation & FormsIncident logs, standardized forms, and record reuse.
  • Situation ReportingSITREP, ICS-209, and briefings from the current incident picture.
  • Companion Field AppAssignment home, task map, check-in, narrative, intel, hazards, messaging, and tablet views.
Connected by design

Follow information across the incident.

A clue can become a map feature, a planned assignment, a team task, a field report, and a change to the command picture. The modules each handle a part of that path.
